description: Create a Stripe Checkout link that adds prepaid credit (plus any bonus tier) to the authenticated account. Give checkout_url to the human to pay in a browser; the balance updates once they pay (check with get_balance). amount_cents must be a whole number between min_cents and max_cents from get_balance.

amount_cents.description: Amount to add, in cents (e.g. 5000 for $50.00).

name: create_topup_link
